trust_decision.summary: Whether a template author (backend user editing CMS pages/partials/layouts or mail templates) may invoke a given method/function on an object inside the Twig sandbox is decided by System\Twig\SecurityPolicy::checkMethodAllowed/checkSecurity, installed on every Twig environment by MarkupManager::makeBaseTwigEnvironment.

landing_point.why: Summary names 'CMS SecurityPolicy' and a bypass of the CVE-2024-54149 model-modification blocklist; the DbModel blocklist is the obvious place to add saveQuietly/forceFill etc.

fix_sites.entry_point: Any sandboxed Twig render (CMS page HTTP request via Cms\Classes\Controller, mail template render) calling a method on an object: blocklist extended for Model/EloquentBuilder/QueryBuilder/Relation/HalcyonBuilder/Datasource/Theme/Controller and '*' (fix.diff:537-777)
Same renders; Twig function names source/constant/enum_cases now blocked in checkSecurity (fix.diff:811-847)
Same renders; transitive __call forwarder chain Model->EloquentBuilder->QueryBuilder enforced in checkMethodAllowed (fix.diff:779-788, 882-898)
Public static API MarkupManager::makeBaseTwigEnvironment(), used by twig.environment, twig.environment.mailer and twig.environment.cms; registers GetAttrAdjuster node visitor (fix.diff:17)
New modules/system/twig/GetAttrAdjuster.php: compile-time node visitor swapping GetAttrExpression for GetAttrNode in every template compiled by the factory
New modules/system/twig/Node/GetAttrNode.php: runtime customGetAttribute casting the receiver before METHOD_CALL or any call with arguments (covers attribute() ANY_CALL)
New SafeCollection proxy: strips callable arguments recursively, keeps string attribute names for hybrid methods, blocks mapInto/pipeInto/toResourceCollection
New SafePaginator proxy: strips callable arguments (through(callable))

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: modules/system/classes/MarkupManager.php:65-68 (factory must register the new node visitor; fix.diff:17) plus new compile-time node fix.diff:322-491 — collection callable-passthrough cannot be closed in the policy at all because checkMethodAllowed never sees arguments (modules/system/twig/SecurityPolicy.php:182)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report is about the method blocklist in SecurityPolicy; Twig functions such as array_*/str_*/html_*/form_* are registered helper functions for theme developers (a neighbouring feature, not method calls on objects), and Collection::map/filter are read-only helpers, so a solver can argue both are outside 'model data modification'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Templates must keep calling read-only collection/paginator methods with string attribute names (items.sortBy('name'), groupBy, keyBy, implode, contains), iterating results, paginator render/links, Twig |map with arrow functions, session put/get/has/forget/flush allowlist, and str_*/array_* helper functions such as str_limit/array_get; blocking all collection method calls or all wildcard helper functions breaks themes.

O6_input_shapes: method called directly on Model (model.saveQuietly(), forceFill, destroy, setTable, unguarded) — fix.diff:584-633
method reached through Model::__call forwarding to Eloquent/Query Builder (model.increment, model.when) — fix.diff:784-788, 882-898
method on Relation / Eloquent Builder / Halcyon Builder obtained via this.page.newQuery() — fix.diff:635-756
string callable argument to collection higher-order method (items.filter('is_numeric')) — fix.diff:1040-1044
callable nested inside array arguments (recursive strip) — fix.diff:1031-1039
non-string callable (Closure/object) on hybrid methods vs string attribute names preserved — fix.diff:1040-1043
attribute(obj, 'method', [args]) compiled as ANY_CALL with arguments — fix.diff:468-471, 215-223

O7_producer.where: modules/cms/ServiceProvider.php:146-160 (compiled CMS templates cached in storage/cms/twig/<theme>; the fix's GetAttrNode only takes effect when a template is recompiled)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Wildcard Twig functions array_*/str_*/url_*/html_*/form_* resolve to any static method of Arr/Str/Url/Html/Form via call_user_func_array, so callable-taking helpers (e.g. Arr first/where/map with a string callable) and Macroable::macro are reachable as functions, never passing checkMethodAllowed; the fix strips callables only for collections and blocks 'macro'/'mixin' only as method names, and blockedFunctions lists only source/constant/enum_cases.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: These are documented theme-helper functions registered by the system module, not method calls on objects; the advisory concerns the SecurityPolicy method blocklist.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different file (modules/system/ServiceProvider.php) from landing point (modules/system/twig/SecurityPolicy.php); dispatch in modules/system/classes/MarkupManager.php:248-253

O8_uncovered_routes.route: form_macro function maps directly to Form::__call, a magic forwarder the fix blocks by name ('__call' in '*') only when invoked as an object method.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Legacy convenience function for invoking registered form macros; looks like a supported feature, not a sandbox object call.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different file from landing point, same system module

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A filter registered as a wildcard ['Arr','*'] or ['Str','*'] (e.g. 'array_*' filter) would forward user-supplied callables to Laravel helpers the same way the functions do.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: registerFilters already uses Str static methods (slug, plural, camel) and MarkupManager::makeTwigFilters supports wildcards (modules/system/classes/MarkupManager.php:297-303); a maintainer adding convenience filters would copy the function pattern.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A further Halcyon/Theme object exposed to templates (e.g. a theme config/customData accessor) whose write method is not listed in the blocklist.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The policy is a blocklist per class; each new CMS object added to the template context needs its own entries, which the original CVE-2024-54149 fix and this fix both had to extend by hand.

O9_family: Sandbox / protection-mechanism bypass (CWE-693): incomplete Twig sandbox blocklist allowing authenticated template authors to modify data and execute PHP callables

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Append saveQuietly/forceFill/destroy and a few more names to the DbModel blocklist in SecurityPolicy, leaving builder forwarding, collection callables, attribute() and the wildcard helper functions open.
